{{Short description|FIFA World Cup group}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=December 2025}}
{{Use American English|date=November 2025}}
Group J of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] took place from June 16 to 27, 2026.<ref name="match schedule">{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/1be9ce37eb98fcc5/original/FWC26-Match-Schedule_English.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 26 – Match Schedule |publisher=[[FIFA]] |date=February 4, 2024 |access-date=February 4, 2024}}</ref> The group consisted of [[2022 FIFA World Cup|defending champions]] [[Argentina national football team|Argentina]], [[Algeria national football team|Algeria]], [[Austria national football team|Austria]], and [[Jordan national football team|Jordan]].

Argentina topped the group with three wins out of three, and Austria finished as runners-up, gaining the edge over Algeria on goal difference. Both teams thus advanced to the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Round of 32|round of 32]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 2026 Regulations |publisher=FIFA |date=May 2025 |access-date=June 7, 2025 |archive-date=June 23, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250623212158/https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |url-status=live}}</ref> In the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage|knockout stage]], Argentina defeated multiple teams but lost to Spain in [[2026 FIFA World Cup final|the final]].

Algeria's four points were nonetheless enough to also qualify for the knockout stage as one of the best third-placed teams. World Cup debutants Jordan finished last with no points and were eliminated.

On June 22, [[Lionel Messi]] scored his 17th World Cup goal in Argentina's win against Austria, surpassing [[Miroslav Klose]] (16) as the FIFA World Cup's [[List of FIFA World Cup top goalscorers|all-time top goalscorer]]. Messi's six goals across the three group matches brought his overall tally to 19 across the six World Cups he had participated in.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/fifa-world-cup-all-time-leading-scorers |title=FIFA World Cup all-time leading scorers |publisher=FIFA |date=June 30, 2026 |access-date=June 30, 2026}}</ref>

==Standings==
{{2026 FIFA World Cup group tables|Group J}}

In the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Round of 32|round of 32]]:<ref name="regulations"/>
* The winner of Group J, [[Argentina national football team|Argentina]], advanced to play the runner-up of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group H|Group H]], [[Cape Verde national football team|Cape Verde]].
* The runner-up of Group J, [[Austria national football team|Austria]], advanced to play the winner of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group H|Group H]], [[Spain national football team|Spain]].
* The third-place team of Group J, [[Algeria national football team|Algeria]], advanced to play the winner of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group B|Group B]], [[Switzerland national football team|Switzerland]], as one of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|eight best third-place teams]] from the group stage.

==Matches==
All times listed are local.<ref name="match schedule"/>

===Argentina vs Algeria===
Argentina had faced Algeria previously only once, a 4–3 friendly win in 2007.<ref>{{cite web|title=Argentina national football team: record v Algeria|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/argentina/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Algeria|website=11v11.com|access-date=December 6, 2025}}</ref> This fixture marked Algeria's first return to the FIFA World Cup since [[2014 FIFA World Cup|2014]], when they reached the round of 16.

With his [[hat-trick]], [[Lionel Messi]] equalled [[Miroslav Klose]] as the [[List of FIFA World Cup top goalscorers|all-time top-scorer]] of the [[FIFA World Cup]], with 16 goals.<ref>{{cite web | title=Messi hat-trick equals scoring record as Argentina dazzle against Algeria | work=Reuters | url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/messi-equals-world-cup-scoring-record-with-hat-trick-2026-06-17/ }}</ref>

Messi also became [[List of players who have appeared in the most FIFA World Cups#Tournaments|the first male player to play in six World Cups]] and [[List of FIFA World Cup top goalscorers#Goalscorers at multiple tournaments|the second player to score in five World Cups]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49013816/lionel-messi-play-6-world-cups-argentina-record-cristiano-ronaldo |title=Lionel Messi becomes 1st man to play at 6 World Cups |publisher=ESPN |date=16 June 2026 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Lionel Messi Ties All-Time World Cup Scoring Record with Hat Trick Against Algeria |url=https://www.foxsports.com/stories/soccer/lionel-messi-matches-cristiano-ronaldos-rare-five-world-cup-scoring-record |access-date=2026-06-17 |website=Fox Sports |language=en-US}}</ref> At 38 years and 357 days old, he also became the oldest player to score a World Cup hat-trick.<ref>{{cite web |last=Milano |first=Bruno |url=https://bolavip.com/en/world-cup/lionel-messi-breaks-cristiano-ronaldos-record-for-the-oldest-player-with-a-world-cup-hat-trick |title=Lionel Messi breaks Cristiano Ronaldo's record for the oldest player with a World Cup hat-trick |publisher=bolavip.com |date=16 June 2026 }}</ref>

===Austria vs Jordan===
The two teams had never met before. The fixture marked Jordan's debut at the FIFA World Cup. This also marked Jordan's very first loss after Austria's formidable form in securing three goals altogether, the second goal caused by a costly own goal from [[Yazan Al-Arab]].

Despite Jordan receiving their very first defeat, [[Ali Olwan]] was named Man of the Match for his consistent performance.

===Argentina vs Austria===
The teams had met on two occasions, both friendlies, with the most recent being a 1–1 draw in 1990.<ref>{{cite web|title=Argentina national football team: record v Austria|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/argentina/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Austria|website=11v11.com|access-date=December 6, 2025}}</ref>

In the 8th minute, Argentina were awarded a penalty after [[Stefan Posch]] fouled [[Lautaro Martinez]] in the box, [[Lionel Messi]] took the penalty but fired wide low to the right of the post. 
In the 38th minute, Messi scored with a first-time left-foot finish from just inside the penalty area to the left corner after a low cross from the left by [[Facundo Medina]]. In the 95th minute, Messi scored again to make it 2–0 when his initial shot was blocked he followed up to hit low to the net from a tight angle on the left past two Austrian defenders.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11095/13554960/world-cup-2026-argentina-2-0-austria-lionel-messi-breaks-scoring-record-with-two-goals-to-send-holders-through|title= World Cup 2026: Argentina 2–0 Austria – Lionel Messi breaks scoring record with two goals to send holders through|date=22 June 2026|work=Sky Sports |accessdate=23 June 2026}}</ref>

In scoring both of Argentina's goals, Messi surpassed [[Miroslav Klose]] to become the [[List of FIFA World Cup top goalscorers|all-time leading World Cup goalscorer]] with 18 goals.<ref>{{cite web |last=Emons |first=Michael |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cze914jw558t |title=Argentina 2–0 Austria |publisher=BBC Sport |date=22 June 2026 }}</ref> He was named Man of the Match and became the third player to score in six consecutive World Cup matches.

===Jordan vs Algeria===
The teams had previously faced each other three times, most recently in 2004, a 1–1 draw in a friendly.<ref>{{cite web|title=Jordan national football team: record v Algeria|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/jordan/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Algeria|website=11v11.com|access-date=December 6, 2025}}</ref>

In the 36th minute, [[Nizar Al-Rashdan]] scored for Jordan with a shot with the outside of his right foot low to the right corner from the right of the penalty area. [[Nadhir Benbouali]] made it 1–1 in the 69th minute with a header to the left corner of the net after corner from on the right [[Riyad Mahrez]]. [[Amine Gouiri]] got the winning goal for Algeria in the 82nd minute when he hooked the ball into the net from close range after another corner from the right broke to him. With this defeat, Jordan were eliminated from the tournament.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/ckg5n4wyzxnt|title= Jordan 1 Algeria 2|date=22 June 2026|work=BBC Sport |accessdate=23 June 2026}}</ref>

===Algeria vs Austria===
[[File:ALGvAUS.jpg|thumb|Algeria and Austria warming up before the match]]
The teams had met once before, in Austria's [[1982 FIFA World Cup Group 2#Algeria vs Austria|2–0 group stage victory]] at the [[1982 FIFA World Cup]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Algeria vs. Austria Head-to-Head in the World Cups|url=https://www.thesoccerworldcups.com/head_to_head/algeria_vs_austria.php|website=The Soccer World Cups|access-date=6 December 2025}}</ref>

A win for either team would guarantee second-place in group J, while the loser would be eliminated. A draw would let both teams advance to the knockout round (with Austria in second-place due to greater goal difference after matchday 2) and eliminate Iran from the third-place rankings following Senegal's 5–0 victory over Iraq. This had raised fears of the [[Disgrace of Gijón]] from the [[1982 World Cup]] repeating.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/live-blogs/algeria-austria-score-result-match-time-world-cup/21Kh08AlDtRf/|title=Algeria vs Austria live score, updates: World Cup 2026 game level in second half after Belghali equaliser|website=The Athletic|access-date=June 27, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title= 'Disgrace of Kansas City' loading? Austria-Algeria clash set to expose World Cup's unfair format - and that could play straight into Gianni Infantino's hands |url=https://www.goal.com/en-gb/lists/disgrace-kansas-city-austria-algeria-expose-unfair-world-cup-format-fifa-gianni-infantino/blt6eca28fc7d7c2381 |access-date=2026-06-28 |website= Goal.com |language=en}}</ref> In the end, both teams gave full effort. The game had a "frenetic pace", with each team having a lead at some point in the second half and each scoring in stoppage time.<ref>{{cite web |author1=ESPN News Services |title=Algeria and Austria's dramatic draw sends Iran out of World Cup |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49203568/algeria-austria-iran-2026-world-cup-draw-advance-eliminated |website=ESPN |access-date=28 June 2026 |date=28 June 2026}}</ref>

===Jordan vs Argentina===
The two teams had never met before. The fixture featured two teams that had both reached finals in FIFA-organized tournaments at the [[Lusail Stadium]] in Qatar. This was the same venue where Argentina won their [[2022 FIFA World Cup final|last World Cup]] on penalties against France, and Jordan competed in the [[2025 FIFA Arab Cup final]], losing 3–2 to [[Morocco national football team|Morocco]].

Argentina came out strong despite having already secured first place, with two goals scored [[Giovani Lo Celso]] and [[Lautaro Martínez]] in the first half. [[Musa Al-Taamari]] then made it 1–2 in the 55th minute. However, with [[Lionel Messi]] subbed in, he scored from a free kick, marking his sixth goal overall at this World Cup.

With this result, defending champions Argentina completed Group J with a perfect 3–0–0 record. In contrast, tournament debutants Jordan suffered three straight defeats, making them, along with [[Uzbekistan national football team|Uzbekistan]] in [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group K|group K]], the only debutant teams to finish without a single point.

==Discipline==
The team conduct ("fair play") score would have been used as a tiebreaker if the head-to-head and overall records of teams were tied. It would also be used as a tiebreaker for the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|third-place ranking]] between groups if the overall records of teams were tied. The score was calculated based on yellow and red cards received by players and team officials in all group matches as follows:<ref name="regulations"/>
*yellow card: −1 point;
*indirect red card (second yellow card): −3 points;
*direct red card: −4 points;
*yellow card and direct red card: −5 points;

Only one of the above deductions could be applied to a player or team official in a single match.
